name: Streams, Temporary Rivulets & Water Network Runtime
design_rules: temporary channels emerge from connected runoff rather than decorative lines
multiple upstream cells may merge into a stronger downstream channel
channels weaken after rain stops and disappear when flow falls below threshold
North Woodland channels persist longer but move slower
Ring Basin channels move faster but disappear sooner
temporary streams remain shallow enough to preserve traversal
water networks never use emissive or glow feedback
